set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=53e270120a0bc61b2af422c6faa4fcd6789f43c3; REPO="$HOME/local-agent"; cd "$REPO"; test "$(git branch --show-current)" = main; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; git fetch --quiet --prune origin main --tags; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"; test "$(git rev-parse 'v4.13.0^{}')" = "$EXPECTED"; ! git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/remotes/origin/v4.13.0-staging; python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
EXPECTED='53e270120a0bc61b2af422c6faa4fcd6789f43c3'
repo=Path.home()/'local-agent'
out=subprocess.check_output(['git','worktree','list','--porcelain'],cwd=repo,text=True)
entries=[]; cur={}
for line in out.splitlines()+['']:
    if not line:
        if cur: entries.append(cur); cur={}
        continue
    key,_,value=line.partition(' '); cur[key]=value
root=str(repo.resolve())
for e in entries:
    path=e.get('worktree','')
    if str(Path(path).resolve())==root: continue
    if not Path(path).name.startswith('local-agent-v413-'): continue
    if e.get('branch'): raise SystemExit(f'refusing cleanup: {path} is attached to {e["branch"]}')
    head=e.get('HEAD','')
    if subprocess.run(['git','merge-base','--is-ancestor',head,EXPECTED],cwd=repo).returncode!=0:
        raise SystemExit(f'refusing cleanup: {path} HEAD {head} is not an ancestor of release')
    status=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',path,'status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=normal'],text=True).strip()
    if status: raise SystemExit(f'refusing cleanup: {path} is dirty')
    print(f'REMOVING_WORKTREE={path}')
    subprocess.check_call(['git','worktree','remove',path],cwd=repo)
PY
; git worktree prune; if git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/heads/v4.13.0-staging; then test "$(git rev-parse v4.13.0-staging)" = "$EXPECTED"; git branch -d v4.13.0-staging; fi; ! git worktree list --porcelain | grep -F 'local-agent-v413-'; ! git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/heads/v4.13.0-staging; ! git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/remotes/origin/v4.13.0-staging; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; echo LOCAL_AGENT_V413_DETACHED_WORKTREE_CLEANUP=PASS
